root_cause.text: A missing vmap_purge_lock acquisition in the vmalloc shrinker path allowed vmap_node_shrink_scan() to call decay_va_pool_node() concurrently with __purge_vmap_area_lazy(), even though decay_va_pool_node() is not concurrency-safe on vmap pool state.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly states that decay_va_pool_node() “can be invoked concurrently from two paths” and “is not safe to run concurrently,” while the patch fixes this by adding `guard(mutex)(&vmap_purge_lock);` at the start of `vmap_node_shrink_scan()` to serialize it with purge users.

intent_record.intent_summary: Protect vmap_node_shrink_scan() with vmap_purge_lock so vmap node decay during shrinker scanning runs safely under mutex synchronization.
intent_record.what: A new statement, guard(mutex)(&vmap_purge_lock);, was added at the start of vmap_node_shrink_scan() before iterating over all vmap nodes and calling decay_va_pool_node(vn, true).
intent_record.how: This acquires vmap_purge_lock for the duration of the function scope using a scoped guard, ensuring the subsequent scan and decay operations run under mutex protection and preventing concurrent access to shared vmap purge state during the loop.

grouping_result.intent: Protect vmap_node_shrink_scan() with vmap_purge_lock so vmap node decay during shrinker scanning runs safely under mutex synchronization.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly adds the missing vmap_purge_lock around vmap_node_shrink_scan(), which addresses the root cause of unsafe concurrent decay_va_pool_node() execution with __purge_vmap_area_lazy().

candidates.rationale: This call performs vmap pool decay from the shrinker path without the required vmap_purge_lock, directly embodying the unsafe concurrent access to vmap pool state described in the root cause.
The shrinker iterates all vmap nodes and invokes decay on each without surrounding mutex protection, enabling concurrent execution against purge logic across the whole pool.

vuln_statements.explanation: This shrinker-path call performs vmap pool decay without holding vmap_purge_lock, allowing unsafe concurrency with __purge_vmap_area_lazy() on shared vmap pool state, which matches the root cause.
